title: Avila Core Attestation v0.1 draft
description: ADR-0021: the authority primitive SC-14 names — a key, in a role, signing a statement about an exact digest-bound subject. The record never asserts the statement is true; it asserts the attribution and the signature. Carried as an `attestation` record inside a campaign JSONL log.

kind.description: Which kind of record the statement covers.

identity.description: The subject's bound identity (contract `id@rev`, campaign id, transition id, or manifest id).

sha256.description: The exact document digest the statement covers.

statement.description: The closed statement vocabulary — the engine checks the word, never the prose.

detail.description: Inert text carrying the stated detail of the statement.

role.description: The technical role the actor asserts — must equal the role the signature's key is listed under in the trust root.

signature.description: The actor's ADR-0015 signature over this record's canonical bytes with this member absent.
